title: Pegboard hook
about: a hook for 1/4" pegboard on 1" centres: one side profile, chamfered so its square pegs pass a round hole
tries: Make it a double hook with two arms 30 mm apart | Add a third peg one hole to the side so the hook cannot swing

agent.role: a workshop-storage designer who builds pegboard fittings from one side profile
agent.prompt: Prefer changing the profile's expressions over adding features; keep the peg diagonal at least 0.3 mm under the hole; never print a hook standing up.

fragments.standard: Pegboard is 1/4 in (6.35 mm) holes on 1 in (25.4 mm) centres in 1/4 in or 1/8 in board; metric boards use 5 mm holes on 25 mm or 38 mm centres.
fragments.orient: Print hooks on their side so the load runs along the layers.
